title: Land at Haneda · Kingyuen wagyu all-you-can-eat welcome feast · Round1 Ikebukuro · Mutekiya ramen

stops.name: Arrive Haneda Airport T3
stops.plan: Land 15:00; immigration, bags, then load a Welcome Suica on every phone before the Keikyu gates.
stops.transport: Keikyu Airport line to Shinagawa, JR Yamanote line to Ikebukuro, Seibu Ikebukuro line to Higashi-Nagasaki, then walk (about 70 min with all the bags)

stops.name: Check in Ninja House
stops.plan: Check in (from 16:00), drop every suitcase here until Dec 18, grab passports and cash for tonight.
stops.transport: Walk to Higashi-Nagasaki, Seibu Ikebukuro line 2 stops to Ikebukuro, walk to the East exit (about 25 min)

stops.name: Kingyuen (wagyu all-you-can-eat yakiniku)
stops.plan: Welcome feast in the 6–8 person private room: wagyu all-you-can-eat course plus nomihodai, booked for 8 (8名・個室).

stops.name: Round1 Ikebukuro
stops.plan: Two lanes of four for a bowling grudge match, then the arcade floor (amusement corner open to 00:50) and a karaoke room if the night demands it.

stops.name: Mutekiya
stops.plan: Queue together for the rich tonkotsu honmaru ramen; counter only, so you eat in two or three waves. Cash only.
stops.transport: Seibu Ikebukuro line Ikebukuro → Higashi-Nagasaki, then walk (12 min); two taxis (about ¥700 pp) if you miss the last local

stops.name: Back at Ninja House
stops.plan: Bed by about 00:30: tomorrow starts at 07:20.
